schema.label: Split monitor set (Windows mode)
schema.description: What to do when the monitors stop showing one desktop as a set. partial: mark the focused monitor's desktop with a hollow indicator until a bar click or SUPER+number realigns the set. follow: realign every monitor to the focused monitor's desktop automatically.
